raw_html: [[Greater Icy Blast]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Greater Icy Blast]]:''' An icy blast weapon is sheathed in icy cold. Critical hits with this weapon deal an additional 4 to 40 cold damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 6 to 60 for a x3 critical multiplier, and 8 to 80 for a x4 multiplier. Additionally, if you roll a 20 when attacking and confirm the critical hit, the weapon blasts your target, doing 6 to 36 more cold damage.
